column1: # Alt written 12 Aug 2026 from contact sheets 04, 05, 07, 09 and 11, plus
# direct renders of 24, 25, 26, 27 (four aerials that all show an airliner
# and had to be told apart) and 41.
# FOURTEEN of Shaurya's fifteen photographs are here. Index 41,
# NOT migrated — see IMAGE-ROLLOUT-STATUS.md. Its signboard reads
# "ग्रुप ग्रामपंचायत वडघर, ता. पनवेल": it is the Vadghar group gram
# panchayat office, a public building in a different village. It is
# currently in Shaurya's gallery captioned "Shaurya — exterior of the
# building", which is wrong twice over, and no honest alt text can also
# end "— Shaurya, Karanjade". Whether it belongs in the gallery at all is
# the owner's call, so it was left exactly as found.
# Two filenames carry parentheses. scripts/image-audit.mjs drops those
# from rename-map.tsv (its reference-scanning regex stops at "("), so the
# two rows below were numbered by hand to the §3.1 convention:
# DSC_0183(1) is aerial-view-05 and DSC_0118%20(1) is exterior-01, which
# shifts the map's proposed numbers for their siblings.
# aerial-view-04 is also the /gallery hero and a site.ts amenity image.
